5. Note the difficulty of the card below the card
1. One of you is the describer and the other is the guesser
2. Guesser hold the phone up to their forehead, screen facing out
3. The describer see te card and describes it, without saying any word shown on it
4. Guesser has 30 second to guess, then the back is shown
5. Check the guess - tilt down if it was right, or tilt up if it was wrong
3. Play a 2 player version against one another
4. see who wins between the two groups
5. Bask in the glory when you eventually win
